name: polycule
title: polycule
blurb: a The L Word–style interactive relationship-graph maker: add characters, connect them with dating / exes / situationship / throuple / messy-history lines, pin any two toward the center, drag the web around, share what you built. @juniperbevensee.bsky.social and @shimmermathlabs.com asked for a real-bot gossip graph; this bot wouldn't fabricate dating gossip about real handles, so it's the fictional version instead — nobody real is pre-loaded, you build the cast.
